parsed.explanation: The objection is correct: since g=gcd(m,n), lcm(m,n)=mn/g, not mn/g². The surrounding conclusion P'=P/g is nevertheless correct, because the selected pair’s product changes from mn to lcm(m,n)=mn/g. Replacing g² by g repairs the displayed calculation and makes the subsequent descent proof valid. No independent proof of the noncoprime product decrease appears elsewhere.
